scope: New Windows-foundation TrollReturn provider. Reuses the caller's loaded OriginalCampaignRuntime and CombatSession; creates no scheduler, animation clock, source trigger, map schedule, or alternate actor/FSM owner.

campaign.script: level TrollReturn, found by name in the caller's exact OriginalCampaignRuntime
campaign.trigger_policy: OriginalCampaignRuntime::trigger_contact receives real inside/qualified/module facts and owns the source edge, triggercount=1, triggerdelay=0, and script start. The helper does not synthesize overlap or call start directly.

actor_and_clips.clip_bank: build_troll_return_source_bank_v1 returns these three additional alias/path pairs for the same Troll visual. They must be merged into the actual Troll actor profile's sourceAnimationClips/visual before CombatSession::initialize. The plan also retains all nine authored Attack leaves so RetainedSequencePlayback sees contiguous source hierarchy container indices, but only the three clip leaves used by TrollReturn are required in this additional preload list.
actor_and_clips.motion: Each source leaf has authored moveGO=1 and speed=1.2999999523162842. The same initialized visual needs its authored motion root and the same CombatSession navigation/collision motion handler before execution. The helper never advances animation itself.

source_contract.sound: Source command 7 is PlaySound kind13 asset328 / UID252 `sfx_cave_troll_smash_ground.wav`, absent in the recovered cache. Original Script_PlaySound is void and ignores playback return, so missing playback is diagnostic and not an unconditional TrollReturn progression failure. No audio is synthesized or downloaded.

implementation_behavior.scoping: The provider recognizes only the exact PlayActorAnim command object addresses from the loaded TrollReturn script. It validates the authored actor receiver, source ID, wait field, Troll Attack leaf path and same loaded campaign owner; unrelated commands are forwarded to the supplied existing cinematic callback.
implementation_behavior.actor_mapping: Each execute resolves the exact authored source object name and module to an ActorId already registered in the passed CombatSession. The callback returns the same object name/module/session and a retained shared actor_binding_lease; the helper verifies that lease against the exact session, then retains the name/module/ActorId/lease and retained pose through completion. Generic animation does not construct or require a canonical native Character object. Missing resolver, mismatched name/module/session/lease, or missing retained pose fails explicitly.
implementation_behavior.playback: Each command starts only its authored Troll Attack leaf through CombatSession::play_actor_source_sequence on the same actor pose owner. OriginalAttackSequence uses source phase speed/path metadata. CombatSession::update remains the only animation clock and uses the session's existing motion service.
implementation_behavior.wait: Wait=1 IsBlocking reads current_ended from the exact retained pose owner; wait=0 remains nonblocking. Update is a no-op for this provider because it cannot advance a second clock. Completion verifies the same session lease, ActorId and retained pose. Source commands later restore idle/camera/lock in their authored order.
implementation_behavior.skip: A reached sampled skip suppresses that authored PlayActorAnim and records an explicit skipped command so wait queries return nonblocking without requiring a nonexistent animation handle. Actual skip/input state remains supplied by the existing source owner.
implementation_behavior.markers: Every reached retained animation marker is forwarded through the required same-session animation-event provider. The implementation does not infer that a marker means the video player was hit.
